title: 国债收益率上行真相：财政溢价为主因，科技发债并非推手
speaker: Monica Schell

segments.en: You know, we are getting some jitters and to some extent, you know, some of the widening overnight is also due to all this rumor about Google tapping.
segments.zh: 市场有些紧张，某种程度上，隔夜利差走阔也与谷歌发债的传闻有关。

segments.en: So I think that's also something that everybody is watching to see how that gets absorbed.
segments.zh: 所以大家都在关注这笔债券如何被市场消化。

segments.en: You mentioned crowding out, crowding out what specifically. Like, what do we need to be watching as far as that specific angle is concerned?
segments.zh: 你提到挤出效应，具体挤出什么？从那个角度看，我们需要关注什么？

segments.en: So, you know, I think that in recent weeks there was some discussion about whether Treasury yields in part was wider because of all these issuance and the need sort of the head for hedging.
segments.zh: 最近几周有讨论认为，国债收益率部分走阔是因为大量发行和对冲需求。

segments.en: But, you know, I think the data has shown that it isn't as much that and that rates is more due to sort of the fiscal premium that the market is pricing in in the sort of term premium.
segments.zh: 但数据显示并非如此，利率更多是由于市场定价中的财政溢价和期限溢价。
